edits.old: - Method, path template, headers and body are fixed per case. Nothing caller-supplied becomes a URL, path, header, method or body, so the endpoint is **not a proxy**.
edits.new: - Caller input is limited to three Zod-validated fields — `runId` (`[A-Za-z0-9]{8,32}`), `caseId` (fixed §4 allowlist) and `refId` (lowercase UUID, supplied only for cases that address a record) — and only the validated `refId` fills the single `{id}` parameter of the fixed `/api/v1/users/{id}` route template, never a caller-supplied URL or path. All other method, path template, header and body values are fixed per case; arbitrary caller-supplied URL, path, method, header or body overrides are forbidden, so the endpoint is **not a proxy**.

- **App-client:** `outcome` (`value` / `apiError` / `abort`); when `outcome` is `value`, `value` carries the harness-local Zod-validated native User object (properties per §4 expectations) and `apiError` is `null`; when `outcome` is `apiError`, `value` is `null` and `apiError.{status, code, message, details}` is present; a caller `signal` abort leaves `value` and `apiError` `null` (client timeouts are `apiError` code `TIMEOUT`, not aborts, per client source); `classification` per §5.5. The shared client returns schema-validated body only on success — success HTTP status and response headers are not observable through it — so wire fields stay `null` (`not-observable-via-client`); wire evidence keeps its own request IDs/records; the shared client is unmodified.

edits.old: - Bodies are capped at 16 KiB, with truncation flagged. Synthetic data only.
edits.new: - Retained bodies (`value`, wire `upstream.body`) are capped at 16 KiB with a `truncated` flag set when capped. Truncation is an envelope-retention boundary only — the client parses and schema-validates the complete response body in memory — but a truncated retained value is never evidence of a complete response: rows asserting full-body equality (T2), field-for-field persistence comparison (INT-PERS-01/02 checkpoints) or full validated/persisted state are recorded BLOCKED (assertion not established, never PASS) unless the retained body is untruncated. Synthetic data only.

The unchanged conclusion cites this chain and its request IDs, never the 503 alone.
